"Acrylamide modification of cysteines" is the explicit name provided in the text for the modification on C. "Carbamidomethyl" is the standard name for this, but the rule says "A modification is CORRECT (VERDICT: high) ONLY when its name -- or an unambiguous synonym... is EXPLICITLY written". "Acrylamide modification of cysteines" is an unambiguous synonym for Carbamidomethyl (C).
